title: Review a material job change
intro: Changed work stays paused until a durable hold and fresh scope decisions are confirmed.
empty: Choose a job change from your job record.
unavailable: The current change is unavailable. Retry this same reference; work is not confirmed to resume.
denied: Access is unavailable for this identity or business. Return to your job record.
pending_hold: Waiting for the durable Orders hold. The old scope remains paused.
awaiting_reapproval: Hold confirmed. Review the new assessment, quote, eligibility and brand decision in your job record before accepting.
pending_resume: Acceptance is retained. Waiting for Orders to confirm the exact new bindings.
reapproved: Orders acknowledged the new bindings. Check the job record for current work authorization.
confirm: Confirm the exact reviewed scope and amount
private: Current private scope must be loaded from the job record. This page does not infer acceptance from an old quote.
